name: TobiDash Tools
description: Experimental local speed, noclip, and icon/color visual-unlock toggles for Geometry Dash.

speedhack.name: Speed hack
speedhack.description: Apply the selected game-time multiplier while playing. This affects the global scheduler, including animations.

speed-multiplier.name: Speed multiplier
speed-multiplier.description: Used only while Speed hack is enabled. 1.0x is normal speed.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Skip ordinary, internal, rotated-object, and slope player collisions while playing. May bypass pads, orbs, portals, and other object interactions; non-collision/out-of-bounds deaths may still occur.

unlock-icons.name: Unlock icons & colors (visual)
unlock-icons.description: Makes local icon and color unlock checks succeed. Does not grant or sync account progress.
